text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: 14.0 to 14.8 s, same creek shot held. The white car sits half submerged in the far part of the water and drifts slightly left, with a small brown splash at its rear right from 14.6 s. A pale tan band runs straight and horizontal across the full frame width along the far edge of the water under the bank, with a straight lower boundary line visible below it, most clearly at 14.0 s. The right-edge ledge steps and the thin curved line hold. The caption box sits over the water just below the car.
